addedGuides.name: Dreadnoughtus
addedGuides.finding: Feed Element to lead a wild Dreadnoughtus to an Element Vein, then defend it while it consumes the vein and gains taming progress.

addedGuides.name: Megaraptor
addedGuides.finding: Activate its altar with a Torch equipped, then interrupt its ambushes with timed torch hits until it falls unconscious. Feed it afterward.

addedGuides.name: Cat
addedGuides.finding: Choose a Cat that is calm toward your survivor, then hand-feed it repeatedly. A frightened or angry Cat cannot be directly tamed by that survivor.
